 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2282846a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Find the largest connected non-background colored object; output its color as 3x3."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    largest_size, winning_color = -1, 0
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color in (0, 7, 9) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                size += 1
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen
                            and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            if size > largest_size:
                largest_size, winning_color = size, color
    return [[winning_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
"
}
